title: Feature Request: Time-Limited SMB Control in Automations
symptom: Automations in AndroidAPS can only permanently enable or disable SMB, requiring two automations to temporarily disable SMB for activities like exercise. This makes management complex and hard to oversee, especially for children with Type 1 Diabetes.
fix: The thread suggests a workaround: set a temporary target higher than 5.5 mmol/L (or 100 mg/dL) with the setting 'Enable SMB with high temp targets' disabled, which disables SMB for the duration of the temp target. However, the user notes this workaround is not always suitable because it interferes with other automations like 'Compression Low'.
settings_changed: Enable SMB with high temp targets → disabled
evidence_quote: You can turn off SMB yourself, by setting target higher than 5.5mmolL/100mg and having setting "Enable SMB with high temp targets" disabled.
